intro: 12 個銀行業務情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: He could not manage his bank account online because the website would not accept his password.
ex.zh: 他無法在網路上管理銀行帳戶,因為網站不接受他的密碼。

ex.en: Without hesitating, she accepted the job of teller.
ex.zh: 她毫不猶豫地接下了銀行櫃員的工作。

note: acceptance 接受;acceptable 可接受的

ex.en: His healthy bank balance showed a long habit of savings.
ex.zh: 他可觀的銀行存款餘額,顯示他長期有儲蓄的習慣。

ex.en: It took him over an hour to balance his checkbook.
ex.zh: 他花了一個多小時才把支票簿的收支對平。

note: bank balance 銀行餘額;balance a checkbook 核對支票簿收支
另有「平衡」之意,如 work-life balance

ex.en: Myra borrowed a pen so that she could sign the check.
ex.zh: 麥拉借了一支筆,好在支票上簽名。

ex.en: The couple borrowed money from the bank to buy a home.
ex.zh: 這對夫妻向銀行借錢買房子。

note: borrow sth from sb 向某人借某物

ex.en: The bank manager spoke cautiously when giving out information to people she did not know.
ex.zh: 銀行經理對不認識的人提供資訊時,說話很謹慎。

ex.en: Act cautiously when signing contracts and read them thoroughly first.
ex.zh: 簽約時要謹慎行事,先把合約徹底讀過。

note: cautious 小心的;caution 小心、警告

ex.en: If you choose, the bank will deduct regular charges, such as electric bills, from your account.
ex.zh: 如果你願意,銀行會從你的帳戶中扣繳電費之類的固定費用。

ex.en: By deducting the monthly fee from her checking account, Yi was able to make her account balance.
ex.zh: 從支票帳戶中扣掉月費後,小怡的帳目就對平了。

note: deduct A from B 從 B 中扣除 A
deduction 扣除額;deductible 可扣除的

ex.en: The stockholders were outraged when their quarterly dividends were so small.
ex.zh: 股東們看到季度股息這麼少,都非常憤怒。

ex.en: The dividend was calculated and distributed to the group.
ex.zh: 紅利已經計算好並分配給這群人。

note: pay a dividend 發放股息
pay dividends 帶來好處、有回報

ex.en: Mary bought her car with an initial down payment in cash and then made her monthly payments online.
ex.zh: 瑪莉買車時先用現金付了頭期款,之後每月在網路上繳分期款。

ex.en: Karl was disappointed when the real estate agent told him he needed a larger down payment on the house.
ex.zh: 房仲告訴卡爾買這棟房子需要付更多頭期款時,他很失望。

note: a down payment on sth 某物的頭期款
make a down payment 付頭期款;monthly payment 月付款

ex.en: Due to low interest rates, Sheila moved quickly to find a good deal on a mortgage.
ex.zh: 由於利率很低,希拉趕緊去找條件好的房貸。

ex.en: Hiram mortgaged his home to get extra money to invest in his business.
ex.zh: 海勒姆把房子拿去抵押,好籌到額外資金投入他的事業。

note: take out a mortgage 申辦房貸;pay off a mortgage 還清房貸

ex.en: The number of free withdrawals a customer can make each month is restricted to five.
ex.zh: 顧客每個月可免費提款的次數限制為五次。

ex.en: Access to the safe deposit box vault is restricted to key holders.
ex.zh: 保險箱金庫只限持有鑰匙的人進入。

note: be restricted to sth 僅限於⋯

ex.en: Once we have your signature, the contract will be complete.
ex.zh: 一旦有了你的簽名,這份合約就完成了。

ex.en: The customer's signature was kept on file for identification purposes.
ex.zh: 為了身分辨識,客戶的簽名留存在檔案中。

ex.en: My checking account allows me to take out money at any bank branch without a fee.
ex.zh: 我的支票帳戶讓我可以在任何一家分行免手續費提款。

ex.en: They took out the chairs in the bank lobby so now there is no place to sit.
ex.zh: 他們把銀行大廳的椅子搬走了,所以現在沒地方坐。

note: take out a loan 貸款

ex.en: Banking transactions will appear on your monthly statement.
ex.zh: 銀行交易會列在你的月結對帳單上。

ex.en: The most common transactions can be made from your personal computer.
ex.zh: 最常見的交易都可以用你的個人電腦辦理。

note: make a transaction 進行交易
